## Maintainer quick-read

The field Type picker is one flat Select of 46 entries ("Text · Text" … "Advanced · Vector") with no search, icons or one-line descriptions. Add typeahead and common types first?

## Options

- **A** — searchable command-list with icons, a *Common* group first and a one-line description per type.
- **B** — typeahead only.
- **C** — status quo.
